$comment: Provenance: written for circsim from manufacturer datasheet figures and the .lib headers, MIT. Datasheet characterization rows for the bundled model library (issue #21). Read by src/simhost/__tests__/characterization.integration.test.ts (npm run test:characterization). Each row names an index.json entry, a bias circuit (raw deck with {{model}}, or a logic setup driven through generateDeck), one measured quantity, the datasheet band, and its source. "expect" is typ with abs or rel, or min/max. "knownFailing": "#N" marks a row that is expected to miss its band because of tracked defect #N; the suite fails as soon as the row starts passing so the marker cannot rot. Sources name the datasheet and the conditions; figures were transcribed from the datasheet families and the .lib headers and are not yet re-verified against vendor PDFs row by row.
